note: GA-132 (the terminal's design, TD): the new tokens for design/tokens.json, in its format. TF0 adds the colours to color.tokens after git-deleted and the sizes to size.tokens after size-statusbar, runs node scripts/tokens-css.ts, and gives size-term-tab and size-term-panel-min their growth in src/styles/appearance.css (terminal-tokens.css shows how). Made by gen-terminal.mjs.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Text a program prints without a colour, and the prompt; as the code's text.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The terminal's background: the code's, so the Editor's panel and the code above it are one surface.

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor: a block while the terminal has the focus, its outline while it hasn't; it doesn't blink.

tokens.name: term-cursor-text
tokens.usage: The character under the block cursor.

tokens.name: term-selection
tokens.usage: The selection, and find's matches (the current one with an accent border): accent at 26% (dark) and 18% (light) on bg, opaque so xterm.js's search can use it.

tokens.name: term-selection-inactive
tokens.usage: The selection while the terminal hasn't the focus.

tokens.name: term-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 0. Dark: a block a little above the background (ls's fifos, htop's bars), and black text on coloured blocks; as text on the background xterm.js lifts it to 4.5:1.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 1: errors, failed tests, git's removed lines and unstaged files. diff-del's value, so git diff reads as the Changes view.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 2: success, passed tests, git's added lines and staged files. diff-add's value.

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 3: warnings, git's commit hashes. The gold of syn-type.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 4: folders in ls, rustc's arrows and line numbers. The blue of syn-function.

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 5: images in ls. A violet: at least 35° of hue from needs (magenta, “needs you”).

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 6: symbolic links in ls, git's @@ lines, URLs. A sky blue: at least 35° of hue from live (teal, an agent at work).

tokens.name: term-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 7: light grey. In dark, text a little dimmer than term-fg; in light, white text on coloured blocks, and lifted to 4.5:1 when it is text on the background.

tokens.name: term-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI 8: grey text, such as hints, a shell's suggestions and dim lines. text-3's value.

tokens.name: term-bright-red
tokens.usage: ANSI 9: bold red (xterm.js draws bold text in the bright colours).

tokens.name: term-bright-green
tokens.usage: ANSI 10: bold green, such as executables in ls and cargo's Compiling.

tokens.name: term-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI 11: bold yellow, such as rustc's warning.

tokens.name: term-bright-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI 12: bold blue, such as folders in ls.

tokens.name: term-bright-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI 13: bold magenta. As apart from needs as term-magenta.

tokens.name: term-bright-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI 14: bold cyan, such as symbolic links in ls. As apart from live as term-cyan.

tokens.name: term-bright-white
tokens.usage: ANSI 15: the brightest white in dark; in light a pale block, lifted to 4.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: size-term-tab
tokens.usage: The terminal tabs' strip, on the Terminal page and in the Editor's panel (28px compact).

tokens.name: size-term-panel
tokens.usage: The Editor's terminal panel the first time: a share of the code column (.ed-main), kept as a share.

tokens.name: size-term-panel-min
tokens.usage: The panel's least height: its tabs (32px) and 4 lines (4 × 20px), with 4px above and below.

tokens.name: size-term-code-min
tokens.usage: The code's least height while the panel shows (6 lines).

tokens.name: size-handle
tokens.usage: The drag handle's grab area, centred on the panel's 1px top border.
